Its visible content spans identity, API management and discovery, App Service, and Analysis Services. The usual user outcome is finding guidance for an Azure product or task; contributors use the README’s contribution guidance to make or report changes. The supplied excerpts contain no source relationships, so the graph shows only the documented reader-to-corpus relationship and does not infer links among article areas.
